Source Evidence and Navigation
|-- Resolve the diagram's repository [diagramSource.ts: resolveDiagramSource]
|   |-- Load project -> require matching projectId
|   |-- Select source context
|   |   |-- Live diagram -> validate diagram; check contentId when supplied
|   |   |-- Saved representation -> requested revision or current revision
|   |   |   |-- Require revision membership in representation
|   |   |   `-- Revision scene -> exactly one matching content diagram
|   |   |       `-- Without contentId, consider source-bound diagrams; ambiguity -> error
|   |   `-- Source-only request -> published bindings + project.sources
|   |       |-- Filter by sourceId when supplied; combine by sourceId
|   |       |-- Conflicting corpus root/kind or repositoryIdentity -> error
|   |       `-- Require exactly one binding -> temporary source-query diagram
|   |-- Supplied sourceId must match selected diagram's binding
|   `-- diagramSource(diagram) -> source query + diagram + access methods
|       |-- binding() -> explicit corpus binding [shared B]; missing binding -> error
|       `-- readText / listFiles -> corpus provider for [B]
|           `-- Missing corpus access -> error; never infer a repository from Project
|-- Selected diagram nodes -> mapped evidence [codePanel.ts]
|   |-- sourceRangeIndex
|   |   |-- sourceContext.contentHash must equal content.asciiSha256
|   |   |   `-- Mismatch -> reject stale mappings
|   |   `-- diagramSource entries -> node + entity + range
|   |       |-- Skip entries lacking a node, entity, or range
|   |       `-- SourceRangeReference
|   |           |-- repo = projectId + sourceId from entity, then binding, then empty string
|   |           |-- path + inclusive, one-based startLine/endLine
|   |           `-- rangeSha256 = SHA-256(originalLines joined with LF)
|   |-- handleNodeSelect -> sort selected nodes by diagram line and column
|   |   `-- resolveNodeResources -> matches + unmappedNodeIds
|   |       `-- Deduplicate identical resource identities; retain all mapping origins
|   |           `-- PanelContent carries diagram/revision/hash, selected IDs and items
|   `-- buildSourceRangeDisplayModel -> preserve diagram order
|       |-- New section when repository/file changes or start lines move backwards
|       `-- Merge overlapping ranges within a section; retain contributing items
|-- Read repository-relative evidence [projectSource.ts + corpus.ts]
|   |-- ProjectSourceService -> resolveDiagramSource -> [B]
|   |   |-- files(projectId, directory, sourceId) -> directory listing
|   |   `-- source(projectId, path, sourceId) -> read full text
|   |       |-- Missing path -> invalid-input; NUL in text -> binary-source
|   |       `-- Return path, startLine=1, lines, sourceSha256 and lspEnabled
|   |           `-- Whole-file SHA-256 [H] is distinct from mapped rangeSha256
|   `-- FilesystemCorpusProvider: git-worktree or filesystem-documents
|       |-- Require matching provider kind; canonical root must be a directory
|       |-- Resolve each relative path segment beneath root
|       |   `-- Reject absolute paths, NUL, backslashes, empty/dot/dot-dot segments,
|       |       missing paths, traversed symlinks and escapes from root
|       |-- listDirectory -> require directory; omit .git
|       |   `-- Repository-relative entries; directories first, then name/path order
|       `-- readDocumentBytes -> require regular file -> bytes -> UTF-8 text -> lines
|           `-- readLines -> validate inclusive one-based range; slice up to EOF
|-- Inspect and navigate source [RepositoryFileExplorer.tsx + SourceCodeView.tsx]
|   |-- RepositoryFileExplorer -> CodeRepoService.listDirectory
|   |   |-- Shared promise cache per service, keyed by project/source/directory
|   |   |   |-- At most 256 entries; rejected requests evicted
|   |   |   `-- Refresh clears project listings and reloads this explorer
|   |   |-- Expansion/subscription state belongs to each explorer
|   |   `-- Expand directories, retry errors, navigate by keyboard, open file via onOpen
|   `-- SourceCodeView consumes preview + mapped range + presentation
|       |-- Read-only rows with line numbers, selected ranges and annotations
|       |   `-- Theme-aware tokenization; plain-text fallback
|       |-- Compacted sections -> hidden-line gap or comment graph
|       |   |-- Reveal whole section or a graph node's original source lines
|       |   `-- Navigation destination expands its containing folded section
|       |-- Restore scroll state or reveal target line; select navigation destination
|       |   `-- Reapply destination selection after tokenization replaces text nodes
|       |-- Optional offscreen deferral with wrapping disabled and >240 rows
|       |   `-- Measured 80-row chunks retain native search, selection and scroll geometry
|       `-- Ctrl/Meta-click or F12 -> source position -> onGoToDefinition, if supplied
`-- Optional definition lookup [projectSource.ts + projectLanguageService.ts]
    |-- ProjectSourceService.definitions(reference, path, position, [H], signal)
    |   |-- No language service -> lsp-disabled; server requires --lsp
    |   `-- Resolve diagram binding [B] -> language.definitions(B.corpus, ...)
    |-- Validate lookup before requesting definitions
    |   |-- Require repository-relative TypeScript/JavaScript file
    |   |-- Require nonnegative integer position within current file
    |   `-- Read current text through corpus provider; recompute whole-file SHA-256
    |       `-- Hash differs from [H] -> reject; reload source before lookup
    |-- One lazy language session per canonical root, shared across panes
    |   |-- Spawn typescript-language-server over stdio
    |   |   `-- Initialize definition capability and UTF-16 positions; reject edits
    |   |-- Serialize lookups through session queue
    |   |   `-- didOpen(verified text) -> textDocument/definition -> didClose if alive
    |   |       |-- AbortSignal -> RPC cancellation
    |   |       `-- Initialization/request timeout: 20 seconds -> dispose session
    |   `-- Dispose after 5 idle minutes, process/RPC failure, shutdown or explicit dispose
    |       `-- Dead session is replaced on a later lookup
    `-- Normalize returned Location / LocationLink results
        |-- Use targetSelectionRange or range; paths become repository-relative
        |-- Non-file URI or non-repository path -> increment outsideRoot
        `-- Deduplicate locations -> return { locations, outsideRoot }
            `-- LSP positions are zero-based UTF-16; mapped source lines are one-based
